# 等级系统
[![在 Modrinth 下载](https://img.shields.io/badge/Download-Modrinth-1bd96a?style=for-the-badge&logo=modrinth&logoColor=white)](https://modrinth.com/datapack/rank-system)
[![Discord](https://img.shields.io/badge/Join-Andy71_Discord-5865F2?style=for-the-badge&logo=discord&logoColor=white)](https://discord.gg/ETzFRjAFSZ)
[![Discord](https://img.shields.io/badge/Join-Articq_Studio-5865F2?style=for-the-badge&logo=discord&logoColor=white)](https://discord.gg/YfCHt9Shrt)

## 概述
此数据包为你和你的朋友们新增了14个等级。
## 命令
/trigger ranks-help 打开帮助中心

/function ranks:ranks 打开等级菜单
## 等级
- **ᴏᴡɴᴇʀ**     | `color:#cc2222` / 红色
- **ᴀᴅᴍɪɴ**     | `color:#00ee00` / 浅绿色
- **ᴅᴇᴠ**       | `color:#ff8000` / 橙色
- **ᴅᴇᴠᴇʟᴏᴘᴇʀ** | `color:#ff8000` / 橙色
- **ᴍᴏᴅ**       | `color:#00bbff` / 暗水蓝
- **ᴍᴏᴅᴇʀᴀᴛᴏʀ** | `color:#00bbff` / 暗水蓝
- **ѕᴜᴘᴘᴏʀᴛᴇʀ** | `color:#ffff00` / 黄色
- **ᴄʀᴇᴀᴛᴏʀ**   | `color:#25f2cc` / 青绿色
- **ʏᴏᴜᴛᴜʙᴇ**   | `color:#ff0000` / 亮红色
- **ᴛᴡɪᴛᴄʜ**    | `color:#aa00aa` / 暗紫色
- **ᴍᴘᴠ+**      | `color:#bb00ff` / 紫色
- **ᴍᴠᴘ**       | `color:#bb00ff` / 紫色
- **ᴠɪᴘ**       | `color:#ffaa00` / 金色
- **ᴍᴇᴍʙᴇʀ**    | `color:#aaaaaa` / 灰色
